SELECT p."ID", p."ChangePasswordOnFirstLogon", p."Discriminator", p."IsActive", p."OptimisticLockField", p."StoredPassword", p."UserName", p."AccessFailedCount", p."LockoutEnd"
FROM "PermissionPolicyUser" AS p
WHERE p."Discriminator" = 'ApplicationUser' AND p."ID" = '01a12f69-401a-7221-8546-568e5f932dab'
ORDER BY p."ID"
LIMIT 1

SELECT s."RolesID", s."UsersID", s."ID", s."CanEditModel", s."Discriminator", s."IsAdministrative", s."IsAllowPermissionPriority", s."Name", s."OptimisticLockField", s."PermissionPolicy", p8."ID"
FROM (
    SELECT p."ID"
    FROM "PermissionPolicyUser" AS p
    WHERE p."Discriminator" = 'ApplicationUser' AND p."ID" = '01a12f69-401a-7221-8546-568e5f932dab'
    ORDER BY p."ID"
    LIMIT 1
) AS p8
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p0."RolesID", p0."UsersID", p2."ID", p2."CanEditModel", p2."Discriminator", p2."IsAdministrative", p2."IsAllowPermissionPriority", p2."Name", p2."OptimisticLockField", p2."PermissionPolicy"
    FROM "PermissionPolicyRolePermissionPolicyUser" AS p0
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT p1."ID", p1."CanEditModel", p1."Discriminator", p1."IsAdministrative", p1."IsAllowPermissionPriority", p1."Name", p1."OptimisticLockField", p1."PermissionPolicy"
        FROM "PermissionPolicyRoleBase" AS p1
        WHERE p1."Discriminator" = 'PermissionPolicyRole'
    ) AS p2 ON p0."RolesID" = p2."ID"
) AS s ON p8."ID" = s."UsersID"
ORDER BY p8."ID", s."RolesID", s."UsersID", s."ID"

SELECT p3."ID", p3."CreateState", p3."DeleteState", p3."NavigateState", p3."OptimisticLockField", p3."ReadState", p3."RoleID", p3."TargetTypeFullName", p3."WriteState", p8."ID", s."RolesID", s."UsersID", s."ID"
FROM (
    SELECT p."ID"
    FROM "PermissionPolicyUser" AS p
    WHERE p."Discriminator" = 'ApplicationUser' AND p."ID" = '01a12f69-401a-7221-8546-568e5f932dab'
    ORDER BY p."ID"
    LIMIT 1
) AS p8
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p0."RolesID", p0."UsersID", p2."ID"
    FROM "PermissionPolicyRolePermissionPolicyUser" AS p0
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT p1."ID"
        FROM "PermissionPolicyRoleBase" AS p1
        WHERE p1."Discriminator" = 'PermissionPolicyRole'
    ) AS p2 ON p0."RolesID" = p2."ID"
) AS s ON p8."ID" = s."UsersID"
INNER JOIN "PermissionPolicyTypePermissionObject" AS p3 ON s."ID" = p3."RoleID"
ORDER BY p8."ID", s."RolesID", s."UsersID", s."ID", p3."ID"

SELECT p6."ID", p6."ItemPath", p6."NavigateState", p6."OptimisticLockField", p6."RoleID", p6."TargetTypeFullName", p8."ID", s."RolesID", s."UsersID", s."ID"
FROM (
    SELECT p."ID"
    FROM "PermissionPolicyUser" AS p
    WHERE p."Discriminator" = 'ApplicationUser' AND p."ID" = '01a12f69-401a-7221-8546-568e5f932dab'
    ORDER BY p."ID"
    LIMIT 1
) AS p8
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p0."RolesID", p0."UsersID", p2."ID"
    FROM "PermissionPolicyRolePermissionPolicyUser" AS p0
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT p1."ID"
        FROM "PermissionPolicyRoleBase" AS p1
        WHERE p1."Discriminator" = 'PermissionPolicyRole'
    ) AS p2 ON p0."RolesID" = p2."ID"
) AS s ON p8."ID" = s."UsersID"
INNER JOIN "PermissionPolicyNavigationPermissionObject" AS p6 ON s."ID" = p6."RoleID"
ORDER BY p8."ID", s."RolesID", s."UsersID", s."ID"

SELECT p7."ID", p7."ActionId", p7."OptimisticLockField", p7."RoleID", p8."ID", s."RolesID", s."UsersID", s."ID"
FROM (
    SELECT p."ID"
    FROM "PermissionPolicyUser" AS p
    WHERE p."Discriminator" = 'ApplicationUser' AND p."ID" = '01a12f69-401a-7221-8546-568e5f932dab'
    ORDER BY p."ID"
    LIMIT 1
) AS p8
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p0."RolesID", p0."UsersID", p2."ID"
    FROM "PermissionPolicyRolePermissionPolicyUser" AS p0
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT p1."ID"
        FROM "PermissionPolicyRoleBase" AS p1
        WHERE p1."Discriminator" = 'PermissionPolicyRole'
    ) AS p2 ON p0."RolesID" = p2."ID"
) AS s ON p8."ID" = s."UsersID"
INNER JOIN "PermissionPolicyActionPermissionObject" AS p7 ON s."ID" = p7."RoleID"
ORDER BY p8."ID", s."RolesID", s."UsersID", s."ID"

SELECT p1."UnitateId", p1."ContId", c."Simbol" AS "ContSimbol", p1."PartenerId" AS "ContrapartidaId", r."Denumire" AS "ContrapartidaDenumire", d."ID" AS "DocumentId", NULL AS "DocumentTip", d."Numar", p1."Deschisa" AS "Data", CASE
    WHEN p1."Debit" > p1."Credit" THEN 'Creanta'
    ELSE 'Datorie'
END AS "Sens", abs(p1."Debit" - p1."Credit") AS "Rest"
FROM (
    SELECT p."Unitate" AS "UnitateId", p."Cont" AS "ContId", p."Repartitor" AS "PartenerId", min(p."UnitateDeschisa") AS "Deschisa", COALESCE(sum(CASE
        WHEN p."Sens" = 1 THEN p."Valoare"
        ELSE 0.0
    END), 0.0) AS "Debit", COALESCE(sum(CASE
        WHEN p."Sens" = 2 THEN p."Valoare"
        ELSE 0.0
    END), 0.0) AS "Credit"
    FROM "Postare" AS p
    WHERE (p."Contrapondere" <> 4 OR p."Contrapondere" IS NULL) AND p."Spatiu" = 1 AND p."Carte" = 1 AND p."FelUnitate" = 2 AND p."Unitate" IS NOT NULL AND p."Repartitor" IS NOT NULL AND p."UnitateDeschisa" IS NOT NULL AND p."Data" <= @panaLa
    GROUP BY p."Unitate", p."Cont", p."Repartitor"
    HAVING COALESCE(sum(CASE
        WHEN p."Sens" = 1 THEN p."Valoare"
        ELSE 0.0
    END), 0.0) <> COALESCE(sum(CASE
        WHEN p."Sens" = 2 THEN p."Valoare"
        ELSE 0.0
    END), 0.0)
) AS p1
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT p0."Unitate" AS "UnitateId", p0."Cont" AS "ContId", p0."Repartitor" AS "PartenerId", p0."DocumentId"
    FROM "Postare" AS p0
    WHERE (p0."Contrapondere" <> 4 OR p0."Contrapondere" IS NULL) AND p0."Spatiu" = 1 AND p0."Carte" = 1 AND p0."FelUnitate" = 2 AND p0."Unitate" IS NOT NULL AND p0."Repartitor" IS NOT NULL AND p0."UnitateDeschisa" IS NOT NULL AND p0."DocumentId" IS NOT NULL AND p0."Unitate" = cub_partida_id(p0."DocumentId", p0."Cont", p0."Repartitor")
) AS p2 ON COALESCE(p1."UnitateId", '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') = p2."UnitateId" AND p1."ContId" = p2."ContId" AND COALESCE(p1."PartenerId", '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') = p2."PartenerId"
LEFT JOIN "Documente" AS d ON p2."DocumentId" = d."ID"
LEFT JOIN "Conturi" AS c ON p1."ContId" = c."ID"
LEFT JOIN "Repartitori" AS r ON p1."PartenerId" = r."ID"
ORDER BY p1."UnitateId"
LIMIT @p
